Name: Farmhouse Retexture to match the weathered floor (path) (1)
Author: Lopoy20
Description:
This mod retextures the Farmhouse so that the porch wood matches the weathered floor (path), and changes the porch on the fully upgraded farmhouse to be the same as the porch as the one in the Farmhouse's second upgrade, if you want the porch to be the same in the fully upgraded farmhouse just recoloured get this mod (nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27042)

i made this because i was using the weathered floor path on my farm and wanted my farmhouse to match it, but I'm uploading it here incase anyone wants to do the same :)

this mod requires SMAPI and the content patcher

Manifest.Name: Weatheredpathhouseretex1
Manifest.Description: changes the house wooden porch to match the weathered path
Manifest.Author: Lopoy
